---
title: "PPI → AKI after ICI"
subtitle: "New-user cohort, time-varying Cox model, 730-day horizon"
---

## The question

Among patients who were **not already on a proton-pump inhibitor** when they
started immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, does *starting* a PPI raise the
hazard of acute kidney injury over the following two years?

## Design

- **Cohort** — 8,911 patients with no PPI at or before ICI start and at least
  one creatinine drawn afterwards.
- **Outcome** — AKI, computed from each patient's serial creatinine **after**
  the ICI start date (KDIGO-style: a creatinine 1.5× the rolling 90-day median,
  or 0.3 mg/dL above the rolling 2-day minimum).
- **Exposure** — PPI, **time-varying**. Everyone is unexposed at ICI start
  (day 0); a patient who fills a PPI on day *k* becomes exposed from day *k*, so
  their pre-PPI follow-up counts as unexposed person-time.
- **Follow-up** — to the earliest of AKI, last creatinine, death, or 730 days.
- **Model** — time-varying Cox, `Surv(tstart, tstop, AKI) ~ PPI`.

## Pipeline

| Stage | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| **Shared helpers** | [`R/ppi_functions.R`](R/ppi_functions.R) | Privacy guards, medication ascertainment, rolling KDIGO comparators, `create_aki()`, counting-process split |
| **Data management** | [`data_management.qmd`](data_management.qmd) | Cohort, AKI outcome, time-varying PPI and steroid exposure, counting-process dataset |
| **Analysis** | [`analysis.qmd`](analysis.qmd) | Time-varying Cox model, cumulative incidence of AKI |
| **Diagnostics** | [`diagnostics.qmd`](diagnostics.qmd) | Mirror window, hazard by time since initiation, induction ladder, death negative control |

## What the diagnostics show

The headline time-varying Cox estimate is large and highly significant, but it
does not survive inspection as a drug effect:

- **Mirror window** — AKI incidence in the week *before* the first PPI
  (6.05 per 1,000 person-days) is essentially the same as the week *after*
  (5.98), and peaks on the prescription day itself (14.43). A drug cannot raise
  risk before it is taken.
- **Time since initiation** — the hazard decays from 9.77 in the first week to
  **0.99 (0.73–1.33)** beyond one year of continued exposure. A nephrotoxin does
  not become harmless the longer it is taken.
- **Induction ladder** — 2.57 → 1.85 → 1.60 → 1.36 at 0/30/90/180-day lags,
  monotone with no plateau.
- **Death negative control** — from day 8 onward, starting a PPI predicts death
  *more* strongly than it predicts AKI (e.g. 3.12 vs 2.49 at days 31–90).

Together these point to the acute clinical episode in which the PPI is ordered —
which also drives the creatinine sampling that makes AKI detectable — rather
than to the drug.

## Cohort

| Step | N |
|---|---|
| ICI-CKD analytic master (as saved) | 17,721 |
| − death recorded before ICI start | 17,718 |
| − PPI on or before ICI start (keep new-users) | 9,081 |
| − no creatinine after ICI (keep ascertainable) | **8,911** |

## Data privacy

`EMPI`, `MRN`, names and dates of birth are used as local join keys only and
never appear in rendered output. `data_management.qmd` is not executed at render
time — it reads RPDR extracts that stay local. `analysis.qmd` renders from
`cache/qc.rds`, which is aggregate-only. Cells below 11 are suppressed.

## Data sources (local only, not in this repo)

- `Final cohort/final_master_0114_raw.xlsx` — ICI-CKD analytic master
- RPDR `_Lab.txt` — serial creatinine (AKI outcome, end of follow-up)
- RPDR `_Med.txt` — PPI dispensings (baseline exclusion + initiation date)

## Dependencies

`dplyr`, `tidyr`, `data.table`, `readxl`, `survival`, `broom`, `ggplot2`,
`scales`, `knitr`.
